headline: Anthropic IPO generates scrutiny over patent disputes and funding restrictions
body: Anthropic's public market entry is drawing legal challenges on multiple fronts, including patent infringement claims and trademark disputes, while the company maintains selective funding policies. For healthcare AI deployments, these legal uncertainties create vendor risk considerations around model licensing and long-term platform stability. Organizations evaluating Anthropic's Claude for clinical workflows should factor potential licensing complications into procurement timelines. The patent litigation specifically threatens the foundational IP that large language models depend on, which directly impacts healthcare vendors building on third-party AI infrastructure.
